title: Stonk
wikitext:
{{Infobox/Item |type = [[Pickaxe]] |rarity = Epic |id = STONK_PICKAXE |source = [[Pearl Dealer]] |museum = yes |museum_xp = 3 |museum_category = mining |reforgeable = yes |enchantable = yes |merchant = Pearl Dealer |buy = 499,999 |sell = 9999 }} The '''Stonk''' is an {{Epic}} [[Pickaxe]] bought from the {{NPCSprite|Pearl Dealer}}. == Obtaining == A '''Stonk''' can be purchased from the {{NPCSprite|Pearl Dealer}}'s shop in {{Zone|The End}} for {{c|499999}}. It comes pre-enchanted with {{Ench|Efficiency VI}}. == Usage == {{ItemInfo |type = Pickaxe |name = Stonk |rarity = e |breaking_power = 1 |mining_speed = 380 |special_effect = {{ench|Efficiency VI}}
Increases how quickly your tool breaks blocks.

When mining [[End Stone]] with this Pickaxe, [[Nest Endermite]]s won't spawn, and [[Experience]] will be dropped. {{Green|5%}} chance to drop an extra End Stone block. }} == Trivia == *The name of the item is a reference to the [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/stonks Stonks] meme. *Outside of areas affected by the custom mining speed mechanics, it was able to instantly break certain blocks, due to {{ench|Efficiency 6}}. ** This allowed the player to pass through 1-block thick wallshttps://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rua9YbQjccs&t=24 and stairs,https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=38v9iWlon7E&t=948 as well as create ghost blocks with high enough {{Stat|spd}}.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rua9YbQjccs&t=24 **This mechanic was however replaced with {{Item|Dungeonbreaker}}, for variety of reasons explained [https://hypixel.net/threads/august-20-primordial-broodfather-changes-dungeonbreaker.5970503/ here]. *Stonk can be used to avoid spawning [[Nest Endermite|Nest Endermites]] while breaking [[Ender Nodes]]. == Demonstration == {{YouTube|31HUpOWF-Wg|align=center|caption=Stonk Demonstration}} == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2026/Jun 24|[[File:Stonk (v2).png|26px]] Added a custom texture for '''Stonk''' as part of the SkyBlock Resource Pack.}} |beta= {{History|2019/August 2|[[File:Stonk (v1).png|26px]] Added '''Stonk'''.}} {{History|0.11|Added {{stat|ms|+510}} and {{stat|bp|+1}} to the '''Stonk'''.}} {{History|0.26|[[File:Stonk (v2).png|26px]] Added a custom texture for '''Stonk''' as part of the SkyBlock Resource Pack.}} }} == References == {{Reflist}} == Navigation == {{Nav/Tools/Mining}} {{Nav/The End}}
